assets.description: Cold start for work in this layer. The rule it exists to state: the scanner DECIDES NOTHING, and neither does an agent reading its output — the carve is an adjudicator's Decision that may overrule any finding. Also that the criterion is a near-SINK rather than a small cut, and that an edge's direction may be a filing decision rather than a fact.

directories.description: The criterion as a schema node. Declared here AND repository-scoped from cat-harness's root declaration, because `resolveSkillDirs` has no caller yet — the same duplication `kg-navigation` and `large-datasets` carry, and the same entry to delete when it is wired.

The pinned detangle measurements — size, cohesion and the authority counts per candidate group, one sidecar each. `dependents: skip` because these are measurements OF THIS repository's graph; a dependent instance's numbers are its own and reproducing the files would hand it this one's answers.

`kg-detangle.ts`, the measurement this instance exists to produce. ONE file, and declaring it is not ceremony: `detangle/` declared its `schemas/` and its `results/` and left the thing that WRITES the results undeclared, so a consumer fanning out over declared directories saw the inputs and the outputs and not the step between them. Declared where it is, for the reason `cat-harness-scripts` gives -- it is an entry point named by path in `package.json`.
